# git-hubby CRDs

`github.interhyp.de_repositories.yaml` and `github.interhyp.de_organizations.yaml`
are copied unchanged from [Interhyp/git-hubby](https://github.com/Interhyp/git-hubby)
(Apache-2.0), `config/crd/bases` at commit `091048c078b60725efb35055f874aaf7dc987146`.
`githubby_test.go` checks the converter's Repository and Organization objects
against them field by field.
